name: Richmond Park Sweet Chestnuts (non-Royal)
short_description: Chestnuts at the park boundary walks.
description: Sweet chestnut trees grow along the perimeter woodland of Richmond Park. Note: foraging is not permitted inside the Royal Park itself, but trees overhang the boundary paths.

name: Bushy Park (boundary paths) Chestnuts
short_description: Sweet chestnuts around the park's woodland edge.
description: Sweet chestnut trees line the perimeter paths adjacent to Bushy Park. Collection of fallen nuts from public footpaths on the boundary is widely practised in October.

name: Ham Lands Nature Reserve Wild Fruits
description: Ham Lands is a traditional Thames flood meadow with scrubby hedges rich in blackberries, elder, hawthorn and rose hips along the Thames riverside paths.

name: Crane Park Island Wild Garlic
short_description: Spring garlic on river island nature reserve.
description: Crane Park Island is a London Wildlife Trust nature reserve in Twickenham where wild garlic carpets the ground each spring alongside the River Crane.
